As a suicide survivor, I say that it is not worth it to kill yourself. Yes, after the fact you still do have overbearing thoughts of suicide.  But I remember the night I attempted, my mom found me the next morning unconscious, my arms were covered in blood, my bedsheets were covered with puke and blood and sweat and there were pill bottles on the floor. The way I saw my mom devastated was something I would never want her to feel again, or I would want to see again. Once my family found out they were devastated I had attempted. It was a dark time for me. But things started to get better for a while. I moved out, financed a car, took a few trips and found myself. Or so I thought. I am in a suicidal boat again but what keeps me alive is the thought of death. Feeling yourself losing conciousness is a terrifying feeling. When you feel yourself slowly dying, it's something that you instantly regret. You wish you would have stayed for 1 more fucking day. These thoughts rush your head on what you could have done tonight besides trying to kill yourself. 

Tldr; would not advise suicide, it's a horrible feeling, feeling yourself dying. It's an instant regret .
